mapper.select: SELECT * FROM contract WHERE appointment_id = #{appointmentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contract ( appointment_id, contract_no, contract_type, party_a_id, party_a_name, party_b_id, party_b_name, property_id, contract_amount, start_date, end_date, sign_status, contract_content, attachment_urls, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{appointmentId}, #{contractNo}, #{contractType}, #{partyAId}, #{partyAName}, #{partyBId}, #{partyBName}, #{propertyId}, #{contractAmount}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{signStatus}, #{contractContent}, #{attachmentUrls}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE contract SET contract_amount = #{contractAmount}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, sign_status = #{signStatus}, contract_content = #{contractContent}, attachment_urls = #{attachmentUrls}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
